correctness.rationale: The descent condition is exactly representative independence of multiplication by (1-k_i) from Z_{r_j} into Z_{r_i}. Right translations are affine with multiplier k_j, so the cross-unit condition is exactly right-invertibility. Direct expansion proves self-distributivity; idempotence is immediate. The compact lcm formulation is equivalent by reducing each divisibility by gcd(r_i,r_j). The embedded exhaustive checker independently tests these interfaces on small moduli and the cited examples.
